claims: Myles Garrett signed a four-year $160 million extension with the Cleveland Browns in March 2025.
The extension averages $40 million per year.
The extension made Myles Garrett one of the highest-paid defensive players in NFL history.
The deal runs through the 2030 season.
Total guaranteed money is approximately $123 million.
The deal extends Myles Garrett through the 2030 season.
In March 2026 the Cleveland Browns modified his contract language to create salary cap flexibility by shifting bonus payment dates to closer to the regular season.
The Browns stated the 2026 restructure was not for trading him.
The contract includes a no-trade clause allowing him to approve any potential trade.
Myles Garrett's highest cap number is projected to be $62,901,225 in 2029.
As of early 2026 Myles Garrett's career earnings are over $149 million.
Myles Garrett is the 2023 Defensive Player of the Year
